column1: # mapping_set_title: "EU AI Act Annex IX (Art.60) <-> SEMIC vocabularies"

# mapping_set_description: "Maps the 5 information items of Annex IX (real-world testing registration, Art.60) to MLDCAT-AP 3.1.0, Schema.org and DPV EU AI Act. The bom: bridge concept in see_also provides the shared abstraction."

column8: Unique identifier for the real-world testing plan maps to dcterms:identifier on the MachineLearningModel or associated Dataset
Parties (providers/deployers) involved in the test map to dcterms:creator; prov:actedOnBehalfOf for delegated roles
Deployers acting under provider's plan in real-world testing
Description of the AI system under test maps to dcterms:description on MachineLearningModel
Intended use of the AI system during testing maps to MachineLearningModel.intendedUse
Testing plan methodology loosely relates to designSpecifications; no direct MLDCAT-AP equivalent for a formal testing plan document
Conditions triggering suspension/termination of the test relate to lifecycle status transitions; adms:status is the nearest MLDCAT-AP concept
schema:description is a closeMatch for the textual description of the AI system under test
Application category of the AI system under test; supplements mldcatap:intendedUse
eu-aiact:RealWorldTestingPlan is the class representing the Art.60 real-world testing plan — exact semantic match for IX.4
